segments.thig6.1:1.1: “Yassa maggaṃ na jānāsi, āgatassa gatassa vā;
segments.thig6.1:1.3: Taṃ kuto cāgataṃ sattaṃ [santaṃ (sī.), puttaṃ (syā.)],‘mama putto’ti rodasi.
segments.thig6.1:2.1: “Maggañca khossa [kho’ tha (syā. ka.)] jānāsi, āgatassa gatassa vā;
segments.thig6.1:2.3: Na naṃ samanusocesi, evaṃdhammā hi pāṇino.
segments.thig6.1:4.3: Yathāgato tathā gato, kā tattha paridevanā”.
segments.thig6.1:6.3: Buddhaṃ dhammañca saṅghañca, upemi saraṇaṃ muniṃ”.
segments.thig6.1:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ pañcasatamattā therī bhikkhuniyo … pe ….
